title: GTA6 Devs Tried Not to Jump on Bandwagon of Passing Trends
description: According to Eurogamer, the developers of GTA6 avoided chasing passing trends that would become outdated by launch, opting instead for their own overblown versions.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Developers Sidestep Passing Trends to Avoid Outdated Content at Launch

Creating timely satire can be a daunting task when a video game's development cycle spans half a decade or more. As reported by gaming outlet Eurogamer, this is a well-known hurdle in the industry—it is the very reason why animated shows like South Park have stuck with their crude art style for decades to react quickly to current events. However, the team behind GTA6 cannot simply replace their world-class tech with paper cutouts.

### Navigating Long Development Cycles

When a project takes many years to build from the ground up, incorporating fleeting internet fads or temporary cultural phenomena risks making the final product feel stale or dated by the time it officially reaches players. According to the recent report from Eurogamer, the developers of GTA6 made a conscious effort "not to jump on the bandwagon" of these passing trends.

Instead of chasing trends that would inevitably become outdated come launch day, the team pivoted toward a different creative philosophy.

### Crafting 'Slanted, Overblown Versions'

Rather than adopting short-lived cultural moments, the developers instead chose to create their "own slanted, overblown versions" of the world around them. This approach aligns closely with the long-running satirical identity of the franchise, which has historically thrived on exaggerated parodies of modern society, media, and human behavior rather than direct, fleeting references.

By focusing on timelessly absurd and heavily stylized interpretations of contemporary culture instead of superficial trends, the development team is ensuring that the satirical edge of the game remains sharp and relevant upon release.

## Editor's Take
The challenge of keeping a massive open-world game relevant during a multi-year development cycle is immense. By choosing to bypass temporary fads in favor of crafting their own exaggerated and satirical interpretations, the GTA6 development team is staying true to the series' roots. This thoughtful approach helps ensure the game's world will feel vibrant and biting rather than dated by the time players finally step into it.
